title: MR1-Ligand Cross-Linking for Metabolite Antigen Discovery by Proteomics
author: Thomas, Dolton, et al.

steps.title: Culture HEK293T for lentivirus
steps.instruction: Seed 0.5–1 × 10⁶ HEK293T cells in 12 mL D10 medium in a T75 flask, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until >90 % confluency (4–5 days). Remove R10 medium, add 12 mL 2 mM detachment medium, incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, harvest cells, centrifuge 400 × g, discard supernatant, and re‑plate at a 1:5–1:10 ratio in 12 mL D10.

steps.title: Culture A549 MR1 KO scMR1 lines
steps.instruction: Seed 1–2 × 10⁶ A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑WT and 1–2 × 10⁶ A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑K43A cells in 25 mL R10 medium in T175 flasks, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until >90 % confluency (6–7 days). Remove R10, add 25 mL 2 mM detachment medium, incubate 10–15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, harvest, centrifuge 400 × g, discard supernatant, and re‑plate over 2–3 additional T175 flasks with 25 mL R10 each.

steps.title: Culture A549 lines for validation
steps.instruction: Seed 0.5–1 × 10⁶ A549 WT, A549 MR1 KO (clone 9), and A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑K43A cells in 12 mL R10 medium in T75 flasks, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until >90 % confluency (4–5 days). Remove R10, add 12 mL 2 mM detachment medium, incubate 10–15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, harvest, centrifuge 400 × g, discard supernatant, and re‑plate at a 1:10–1:20 ratio in 12 mL R10.

steps.title: Culture TPR Jurkat reporter cells
steps.instruction: Seed 0.5–1 × 10⁶ untransduced and MC.7.G5‑TCR‑transduced TPR Jurkat cells in 20–30 mL R10 medium in T75 flasks, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until cell density exceeds 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL (5–6 days). Split 1:10–1:20 by resuspending, removing 90–95 % of the volume, and adding fresh R10 medium.

steps.title: Plate HEK293T for transfection
steps.instruction: Detach HEK293T cells as described above, count with a haemocytometer using a 1:1 trypan‑blue mix, and plate 1.25 × 10⁶ cells per well of a 6‑well plate in 3 mL D10 medium per well (24 h before transfection).

steps.title: Prepare scMR1 plasmid mix
steps.instruction: In an Eppendorf tube combine per 6‑well (1 × well): 1.5 µg scMR1‑rCD2‑pELNS plasmid, 0.7 µg pMD2.G plasmid, 1.8 µg pMDLg/pRRE plasmid, 1.8 µg pRSV‑REV plasmid, 1 µg polyethylenimine, and add Opti‑MEM™ up to 300 µL total. Incubate 15 min at 20–25 °C.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293T and harvest virus
steps.instruction: Add the 300 µL plasmid mixture drop‑wise to each pre‑plated HEK293T well, incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, replace medium with 3 mL fresh D10, and collect supernatant at 48 h and 72 h post‑transfection. Combine the two collections and filter through a 0.45 µm polyethersulfone membrane. Use immediately or store at –80 °C (thaw on ice, single‑use, no refreeze).

steps.title: Plate A549 MR1 KO for transfection
steps.instruction: Detach A549 MR1 KO cells as described, count with a haemocytometer using a 1:1 trypan‑blue mix, and plate 0.1–0.2 × 10⁶ cells per well of a 24‑well plate in 2 mL R10 medium per well (24 h before transduction).

steps.title: Spinfect A549 with lentivirus
steps.instruction: Immediately before transduction, remove R10 medium, add 0.5–1 mL fresh R10 medium mixed 1:1 (v/v) with fresh or thawed lentiviral supernatant, add polybrene to a final concentration of 5 µg/mL, centrifuge at 400 × g for 2 h (spinfection), then incubate 14–16 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ without disturbance. Aspirate medium, replace with fresh R10, and maintain cells for 7 days post‑transduction. Assess MR1 surface expression by antibody staining (see later step). Follow biosafety guidelines for GM material.

steps.title: Enrich MR1‑positive cells by FACS
steps.instruction: Detach A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑WT and A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑K43A cells, count, and transfer 1 × 10⁶ of each into a FACS tube. Wash with 4 mL D‑PBS, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant. Stain with LIVE/DEAD® Fixable Violet Dead Stain Kit (add 2 µL of a 1:40 dilution in D‑PBS, vortex, incubate 5 min at 20–25 °C in the dark). Add 1 µL MR1‑PE antibody (clone 26.5, 2 µg/mL, BioLegend), vortex, incubate 20 min on ice in the dark. Wash once as before. Sort live MR1‑positive cells on a BD FACS Aria III using a final volume of 100 µL D‑PBS per sample. Culture sorted cells for downstream use or freeze as stocks.

steps.title: Optional cryopreservation of MR1 cells
steps.instruction: Detach the sorted A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑WT and A549 MR1 KO + scMR1‑K43A cells, count, resuspend 1 × 10⁶ cells per 1 mL freezing buffer, and freeze using Mr Frosty or CoolCell containers to achieve ~‑1 °C/min cooling. For recovery, thaw rapidly at 37 °C and reseed into 12 mL pre‑warmed R10 medium in a T75 flask.
